# Satohash

> Bitcoin-anchored proof of existence via OpenTimestamps. Free. File never leaves the device.

- Stamp: https://satohash.io/stamp
- Verify: https://satohash.io/verify
- Docs: https://satohash.io/docs
- Counsel: https://satohash.io/counsel
- Status: https://satohash.io/status
- API: https://api.satohash.io
- Family stamp: https://satohash.io/stamp?hash=<64hex>&ref=<productId>

Pending means calendars have the hash. Confirmed means a Bitcoin block includes it.
